title: The Unapologetic Man Podcast: How to Meet, Attract, and Date More Women
author: Mark Sing
description: Learn exactly how to talk to girls, how to approach women, how to get a girlfriend, how to get out of the friend zone, how to get a girl's phone number, how to build attraction, how to master the dating apps, and how to have sex with the women you want — all while becoming the most confident, masculine, and powerful version of yourself. Hosted by Mark Sing, an elite NLP dating coach for men, this show breaks down everything you need to master seduction, attraction, masculine frame, confidence, communication, mindset, inner game, charisma, social skills, flirting, body language, and emotional control. Whether you're trying to meet women in real life, improve your online dating game, or finally stop being the "nice guy" and start being the man women chase, you'll discover step-by-step strategies to win with dating, relationships, sex, self-development, success, and confidence — without apology. Each episode delivers powerful insights drawn from NLP (Neuro-Linguistic Programming), psychology, evolutionary biology, and social dynamics, teaching you how to command respect, ignite desire, and live like a high-value man. If you've ever searched "how to attract women," "how to flirt," "how to be confident," or "how to get girls to like you," you've just found your new favorite podcast.
